text:
The revised change spec sections (`header.json`, `units-002.json`, and `units-003.json`) have been updated and accepted by `plan-lint`:

1. **`header.json` (Decision `text-highlight-popup-id`)**:
   - Replaced the `"isolated local popup state"` wording with a concrete decision explaining how `actionChangeTextHighlight` owns a distinct `"textHighlight"` popup id in `AppState["openPopup"]` while staying strictly within the 32 allowlisted files (`types.ts`, `actionProperties.tsx`, `Actions.tsx`) and keeping the sticky-note background picker visible during label editing (preserving `stickyNotes.test.tsx`).

2. **`units-002.json` (`U11`, `U14`, `U16`)**:
   - **`U11` (`packages/excalidraw/types.ts`)**: Added site `S1` (line 483) extending `AppState["openPopup"]` with `| "textHighlight"`.
   - **`U14` (`packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`)**:
     - `actionChangeTextHighlight.perform` translates `value.openPopup === "elementBackground"` from `ColorPicker`'s `updateData({ openPopup: type })` into `openPopup: "textHighlight"` on the returned `appState`.
     - `actionChangeTextHighlight.PanelComponent` passes `<ColorPicker type="elementBackground" ... />` a derived `appState` view where `openPopup: "textHighlight"` is mapped to `"elementBackground"` (so its `Popover.Root` opens only when `app.state.openPopup === "textHighlight"`) and `openPopup: "elementBackground"` is mapped to `"canvasBackground"` (so opening the sticky-note background picker does not open the highlight picker, while `isColorPickerPopup` stays true).
     - `actionChangeStrokeColor.PanelComponent` and `actionChangeBackgroundColor.PanelComponent` map `appState.openPopup === "textHighlight"` to `"canvasBackground"` on the `appState` prop passed to `ColorPicker` so `isColorPickerPopup` stays true while `openPopup !== type`.
   - **`U16` (`packages/excalidraw/components/Actions.tsx`)**: Renders `renderAction("changeTextHighlight")` in the text section without hiding `changeBackgroundColor` during sticky-note label editing, since the two pickers now have disjoint `AppState["openPopup"]` values (`"textHighlight"` vs `"elementBackground"`).

3. **`units-003.json` (`U25` — `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.test.tsx`)**:
   - Added the jsdom test case `"while editing a sticky-note label, opening the highlight picker does not open the background picker"` verifying that both pickers render while editing a sticky-note label and clicking the highlight picker trigger sets `h.state.openPopup === "textHighlight"` and renders only one `.color-picker-content` popover.
